interval_policy: 2000 game-date cluster bootstrap resamples, fixed seed 417
limitations: All seasons have previously been examined; later seasons are chronological confirmation, not an untouched holdout.
Historical input receipt times and actual account access, limits, liquidity and execution are unverified.
Independent listed starts and final-score agreement corroborate identity, not actual tipoff or bookmaker opening/closing.
Missing games remain excluded and coverage is not full league completeness; no synthetic prices are supplied.
Bootstrap intervals cluster games by date but do not capture every model-selection or season-regime uncertainty.
No forward paper picks, live strategy approval, production model changes or website deployment.
quote_selection: latest eligible same-local-game-date snapshot; same-book, same-line, same-update-time pair
